snippet.title: Monster Hunter Stories 2 - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Saddle up for an unforgettable adventure, filled with mythical monsters, brave characters, and ominous mysteries! Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin takes flight on Nintendo Switch and Steam on July 9th.

Get a glimpse of our post-launch roadmap of free updates, including the Palamute from Monster Hunter Rise, a co-op quest to battle the Kulve Taroth, and powerful additional Monsties!

Start your journey early on Nintendo Switch with the Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin Trial Ver., and take your story progress into the full game, at launch!

[Nintendo eShop] 
https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/monster-hunter-stories-2-wings-of-ruin-switch/

[Steam]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1277400/Monster_Hunter_Stories_2_Wings_of_Ruin/
